blocks.original_text:
- name: int_jira__user_activity_metrics
      description: Daily Jira user engagement metrics with rolling windows, tiers, consistency, lifecycle, productivity, and churn risk (one row per user_id, activity_date, project_id)
      grain: One row per user_id per activity_date per project_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__comment
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Build base_activities (union all): - issue_created: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = issue.created_at as date, project_id = issue.project_id, weight = 1; include only if issue.creator_user_id is not null. - issue_assigned: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = issue.created_at as date, project_id = issue.project_id, weight = 2; include only if issue.assignee_user_id is not null. - comment_created: user_id = comment.author_user_id, activity_date = comment.created_at as date, project_id from the linked issue, weight = 1; include only if comment.author_user_id is not null. - field_updated: user_id = issue.assignee_user_id, activity_date = history.updated_at as date, project_id from the linked issue, weight = 0.5; include only if history.is_active is true and issue.assignee_user_id is not null. - From base_activities, exclude rows with null user_id; then aggregate per (user_id, activity_date, project_id): - daily_activity_score = sum of activity_weight; duplicates are kept. - daily_activity_count = total activity rows; distinct_activity_types = count of unique activity_type (both internal only). - Compute rolling metrics on these daily rows, partitioned by user_id and ordered by activity_date (row-based windows; gaps are ignored; if a user has multiple project rows on the same date, each row is counted separately): - rolling_7d_activity_score = sum of daily_activity_score across the current row and up to 6 prior rows. - rolling_30d_activity_score = sum of daily_activity_score across the current row and up to 29 prior rows. - active_days_in_7d = number of rows across the current row and up to 6 prior rows. - active_days_in_30d = number of rows across the current row and up to 29 prior rows. - prev_day_activity = the previous row’s daily_activity_score for the same user. - Derive patterns: - activity_velocity = 0 if there is no previous row; otherwise daily_activity_score minus the previous row’s value. - engagement_tier_7d: ≥20 → "Highly Active"; ≥10 → "Moderately Active"; ≥5 → "Lightly Active"; >0 → "Minimally Active"; else "Inactive". - engagement_tier_30d: ≥50 → "Highly Active"; ≥25 → "Moderately Active"; ≥10 → "Lightly Active"; >0 → "Minimally Active"; else "Inactive". - consistency_score_7d = round(active_days_in_7d / 7.0, 3); consistency_score_30d = round(active_days_in_30d / 30.0, 3). - user_pattern_type: if active_days_in_7d ≥ 5 and rolling_7d_activity_score ≥ 15 → "Power User"; else if active_days_in_7d ≥ 3 and consistency_score_7d ≥ 0.4 → "Regular User"; else if rolling_7d_activity_score > 0 and active_days_in_7d ≤ 2 → "Sporadic User"; else "Dormant User". - Lifecycle stage: - If activity_date equals the user''s earliest activity_date → "New". - Else if activity_date is within 30 calendar days of the earliest activity_date → "Onboarding". - Else if rolling_30d_activity_score is greater than the value 7 rows earlier for the same user → "Growing". - Else if rolling_30d_activity_score is less than the value 7 rows earlier for the same user → "Declining". - Else "Stable". - Productivity and churn risk: - is_productive_today = true if daily_activity_score > 0 and consistency_score_7d > 0.5; else false. - at_churn_risk = true if rolling_7d_activity_score = 0 and the value 7 rows earlier for the same user is > 0; else false. - Return rows where user_id is not null; ordering is by user_id, activity_date (ordering does not affect values).'
      columns:
      - name: user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: User identifier used for grouping and window partitioning; sourced from issue.assignee_user_id or comment.author_user_id; non-null in output
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_date
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar date of aggregated activity for the user and project (from issue.created_at, comment.created_at, or field_history.updated_at coerced to date); non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project associated to the activity (always from the linked issue); non-null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: daily_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Sum of activity weights for the user-date-project (issue_created=1, issue_assigned=2, comment_created=1, field_updated=0.5); duplicates preserved; positive; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: rolling_7d_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Row-based sum across the current and previous 6 user rows; skips inactive days; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: rolling_30d_activity_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: Row-based sum across the current and previous 29 user rows; skips inactive days; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately; 1-decimal precision
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_days_in_7d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of user rows in the current-and-previous-6-row window; minimum 1; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: active_days_in_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Count of user rows in the current-and-previous-29-row window; minimum 1; multiple project rows on the same date are counted separately
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: activity_velocity
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Change versus the previous user row by activity_date: 0 if no previous row; otherwise daily_activity_score minus the previous row’s value; may be negative; 1-decimal precision'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_tier_7d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from rolling_7d_activity_score: ≥20 Highly Active; ≥10 Moderately Active; ≥5 Lightly Active; >0 Minimally Active; else Inactive'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: engagement_tier_30d
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Tier from rolling_30d_activity_score: ≥50 Highly Active; ≥25 Moderately Active; ≥10 Lightly Active; >0 Minimally Active; else Inactive'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: consistency_score_7d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: active_days_in_7d divided by 7.0; row-based; values >0 and ≤1'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: consistency_score_30d
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Rounded to 3 decimals: active_days_in_30d divided by 30.0; row-based; values >0 and ≤1'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: user_pattern_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Classification: Power User (active_days_in_7d≥5 and rolling_7d_activity_score≥15), Regular User (active_days_in_7d≥3 and consistency_score_7d≥0.4), Sporadic User (rolling_7d_activity_score>0 and active_days_in_7d≤2), else Dormant User'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: lifecycle_stage
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Stage: New (first activity_date), Onboarding (within 30 days of first), Growing (rolling_30d exceeds the value 7 rows earlier), Declining (rolling_30d is below the value 7 rows earlier), else Stable'
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_productive_today
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if daily_activity_score > 0 and consistency_score_7d > 0.5; else false; never null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: at_churn_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if rolling_7d_activity_score = 0 and the value 7 rows earlier is > 0; else false; never null
        tests:
        - not_null

- name: int_jira__user_metrics
      description: 'User-level metrics for assigned issues: counts plus average and median time-to-close and open-age, derived from last_assigned_at, resolved_at, and the current time.'
      grain: One row per user_id (assignee_user_id)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      business_logic: 'Dataset and grain: - Use intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and keep only records with assignee_user_id present. - Produce one record per assignee_user_id, labeled as user_id. Per-user counts: - count_closed_issues: number of assigned issues that are resolved. - count_open_issues: number of assigned issues that remain unresolved. Per-issue durations (in seconds): - Close duration: time between last_assigned_at and resolved_at for resolved issues; computed only when both timestamps exist, otherwise treated as missing. - Open age: time between last_assigned_at and the query runtime for unresolved issues; computed only when last_assigned_at exists, otherwise treated as missing. Sums: - sum_close_time_seconds: sum of non-missing close durations. - sum_current_open_seconds: sum of non-missing open ages. Averages (seconds): - avg_close_time_seconds: if there are no closed issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of close durations by the closed issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: if there are no open issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of open ages by the open issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. references.line_text: business_logic: 'Dataset and grain: - Use intermediate.int_jira__issue_join and keep only records with assignee_user_id present. - Produce one record per assignee_user_id, labeled as user_id. Per-user counts: - count_closed_issues: number of assigned issues that are resolved. - count_open_issues: number of assigned issues that remain unresolved. Per-issue durations (in seconds): - Close duration: time between last_assigned_at and resolved_at for resolved issues; computed only when both timestamps exist, otherwise treated as missing. - Open age: time between last_assigned_at and the query runtime for unresolved issues; computed only when last_assigned_at exists, otherwise treated as missing. Sums: - sum_close_time_seconds: sum of non-missing close durations. - sum_current_open_seconds: sum of non-missing open ages. Averages (seconds): - avg_close_time_seconds: if there are no closed issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of close durations by the closed issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. - avg_age_currently_open_seconds: if there are no open issues, set to 0; otherwise divide the sum of open ages by the open issue count and round to the nearest whole second. If the count is non-zero but no valid durations exist, the result is NULL. Medians (seconds): - median_close_time_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing close durations, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. - median_age_currently_open_seconds: continuous 50th percentile of non-missing open ages, rounded to the nearest whole second; NULL if no valid durations exist. Days conversions: - avg_close_time_days and avg_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates; 0 seconds yields 0 days. - median_close_time_days and median_age_currently_open_days: convert their seconds metrics to days by dividing by 86400 and round to the nearest whole day; NULL propagates. Notes: - Open-age metrics depend on query execution time due to use of the current time. - Rounding is to the nearest integer for both seconds and days.'

- name: jira__daily_issue_field_history
      description: Simplified per-row snapshot using the created_at date; fields copied from int_jira__issue_join with status name joined from staging via left join.
      grain: One row per source row in intermediate.int_jira__issue_join (issue_id may repeat)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      - staging.stg_jira__status
      business_logic: '- Create a base set from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join: issue_id; date_day = the date part of created_at; date_week = same as date_day; assignee = assignee_user_id; reporter = reporter_user_id; priority = priority_id; issue_type = issue_type_id; components, story_points, and story_point_estimate are set to NULL; carry status_id for joining. - Left join to staging.stg_jira__status to add status name by matching status_id as text on both sides; if no match, status is NULL. - Compute issue_day_id by hashing the string formed as date_day + "|" + issue_id (in that order); if date_day or issue_id is NULL, issue_day_id is NULL. - No aggregation, filtering, or sorting; output preserves one row per input row; string values keep original casing and spacing unless set to NULL above.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Date part of created_at; NULL if created_at is NULL.
      - name: date_week
        data_type: DATE
        description: Equal to date_day; no weekly rollup.
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue identifier from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join; may be NULL.
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status name joined from staging.stg_jira__status by status_id; NULL if no match.
      - name: components
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL in this model.
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type identifier copied from issue_type_id; may be NULL.
      - name: assignee
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user identifier from assignee_user_id; may be NULL.
      - name: reporter
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from reporter_user_id; may be NULL.
      - name: priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from priority_id; may be NULL.
      - name: story_points
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL in this model.
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Always NULL in this model.
      - name: issue_day_id
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: Deterministic hash of date_day and issue_id joined by '|' in that order; NULL if either input is NULL.

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__daily_sprint_issue_history
      description: Daily issue-level sprint history built from a global date spine, enriched with current issue fields and deterministic sprint/issue status flags for burndown
      grain: One row per sprint_id + issue_id + date_day
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_sprint
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      business_logic: '- Build sprint_issue_mapping from intermediate.int_jira__issue_sprint by keeping rows with a non-null current_sprint_id and selecting sprint_id, issue_id, issue_key, sprint_name, sprint_started_at, sprint_ended_at, sprint_completed_at, and board_id. - Create a global date spine: - start_date is the earliest issue creation date across staging.stg_jira__issue. - end_date is the latest of the issue resolution date, or today for unresolved issues. - Generate one date_day for each calendar day from start_date through end_date inclusive. - For each date_day, set date_week to (year of date_day) * 100 + (week-of-year of date_day). - Cross join the mapping with the date spine and retain only days on or after the sprint start date; include days up to seven days after the sprint end when an end date exists; if the end date is missing, keep all days on or after the start date. - Enrich each row by joining marts.jira__issue_enhanced on issue_id to bring the current, non-historical fields: issue_created_at, issue_resolved_at, assignee_user_id, assignee_name, original_estimate_seconds, remaining_estimate_seconds, time_spent_seconds, and status. - Derive story_points deterministically from a hash of issue_id: compute r = abs(hash(issue_id) mod 10); map r=0→8, r=1→5, r=2→3, r=3→2, r=4→1; all other r values yield NULL; copy story_points into story_point_estimate. - Per-day flags: - is_sprint_active is true on and after the sprint start date and, when present, through the sprint end date; otherwise false. - is_sprint_completed is true on and after the sprint completion date when present; otherwise false. - is_issue_open is true on and after the issue creation date only while the issue has no resolution timestamp; otherwise false. - is_issue_resolved_in_sprint is true on and after the resolution date when the resolution occurred on or before the sprint end; otherwise false. - days_left_in_sprint is the whole-day difference between the sprint end date and date_day when date_day is within the sprint start–end window (inclusive); otherwise NULL; zero on the end date. - Generate sprint_issue_day_id as a stable 64-bit hash of the string "date_day|sprint_id|issue_id", with date_day formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and "|" as the delimiter. - Return all columns and order rows by sprint_id, issue_id, and date_day.'
      columns:
      - name: sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint identifier from int_jira__issue_sprint.current_sprint_id; not null due to filter
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue identifier; join key to jira__issue_enhanced; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from int_jira__issue_sprint; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: DATE
        description: Calendar day from the global date spine; one row per sprint_id+issue_id+date_day; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_week
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Week index computed as (year of date_day)*100 + (week-of-year of date_day); deterministic
      - name: sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sprint name from int_jira__issue_sprint.current_sprint_name; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: sprint_started_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint start timestamp; bounds rows where date_day is on or after the start date
      - name: sprint_ended_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint end timestamp; daily rows extend through seven days after the end date; may be null
      - name: sprint_completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint completion timestamp; used for is_sprint_completed; may be null
      - name: board_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Jira board identifier associated with the sprint; may be null
      - name: issue_created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue creation timestamp from jira__issue_enhanced.created_at; not null
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue resolution timestamp from jira__issue_enhanced; null if unresolved; used in flags
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user identifier from jira__issue_enhanced; may be null
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee display name from jira__issue_enhanced; may be null
      - name: original_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original time estimate in seconds from jira__issue_enhanced; non-negative when present; null allowed
        tests:
        - original_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR original_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: remaining_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining time estimate in seconds from jira__issue_enhanced; non-negative when present; null allowed
        tests:
        - remaining_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR remaining_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: time_spent_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Time spent in seconds from jira__issue_enhanced; non-negative when present; null allowed
        tests:
        - time_spent_seconds IS NULL OR time_spent_seconds >= 0
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current issue status from jira__issue_enhanced.current_status; static across dates (no historical tracking)
      - name: story_points
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Deterministic pseudo-story points based on issue_id hash: r=0→8, r=1→5, r=2→3, r=3→2, r=4→1; other r values yield null'
        tests:
        - story_points IS NULL OR story_points >= 0
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Exact copy of story_points for convenience; same null and value semantics
        tests:
        - story_point_estimate IS NULL OR story_point_estimate >= 0
      - name: is_sprint_active
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when date_day is on or after the sprint start date and, when present, on or before the sprint end date; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_sprint_completed
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when a sprint completion timestamp exists and date_day is on or after that date; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_issue_open
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True when date_day is on or after issue_created_at and there is no resolution timestamp; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: is_issue_resolved_in_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True on and after the resolution date when a resolution exists and it occurred on or before the sprint end; else false
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: days_left_in_sprint
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Whole days remaining until the sprint end when date_day is within the sprint start–end window (inclusive); else null; zero on the end date; non-negative
        tests:
        - days_left_in_sprint IS NULL OR days_left_in_sprint >= 0
      - name: sprint_issue_day_id
        data_type: UBIGINT
        description: Unsigned 64-bit hash of the string 'date_day|sprint_id|issue_id' using '|' as the delimiter and date_day formatted as YYYY-MM-DD; stable; not null
        tests:
        - not_null

map r=0→8, r=1→5, r=2→3, r=3→2, r=4→1; all other r values yield NULL; copy story_points into story_point_estimate. - Per-day flags: - is_sprint_active is true on and after the sprint start date and, when present, through the sprint end date; otherwise false. - is_sprint_completed is true on and after the sprint completion date when present; otherwise false. - is_issue_open is true on and after the issue creation date only while the issue has no resolution timestamp; otherwise false. - is_issue_resolved_in_sprint is true on and after the resolution date when the resolution occurred on or before the sprint end; otherwise false. - days_left_in_sprint is the whole-day difference between the sprint end date and date_day when date_day is within the sprint start–end window (inclusive); otherwise NULL; zero on the end date. - Generate sprint_issue_day_id as a stable 64-bit hash of the string "date_day|sprint_id|issue_id", with date_day formatted as YYYY-MM-DD and "|" as the delimiter. - Return all columns and order rows by sprint_id, issue_id, and date_day.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__issue_enhanced
      description: Enhanced JIRA issue view built from base issues joined with the most recent daily field history and duration metrics computed at query time
      grain: One row per issue_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
      - marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history
      business_logic: '- Begin with all columns from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join as the base issue record. - From marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history, select the most recent record per issue_id based on the largest date_day; if multiple rows share the same most recent date_day, one is chosen arbitrarily because no secondary tie-break is defined. - Left join the most recent daily field history to the base issue on issue_id. - Compute three duration metrics in seconds: - open_duration_seconds: time from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if created_at is NULL. - any_assignment_duration_seconds: time from first_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if first_assigned_at is NULL. - last_assignment_duration_seconds: time from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if last_assigned_at is NULL. - Output includes all base issue columns plus status, components, assignee, reporter, priority, story_points, and story_point_estimate from the most recent daily field history.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Primary issue identifier from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: parent_issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: original_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Original time estimate in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - original_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR original_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: remaining_estimate_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Remaining time estimate in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - remaining_estimate_seconds IS NULL OR remaining_estimate_seconds >= 0
      - name: time_spent_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Total time spent on the issue in seconds from base issue
        tests:
        - time_spent_seconds IS NULL OR time_spent_seconds >= 0
      - name: assignee_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee user identifier from base issue
      - name: created_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue creation timestamp from base issue; start point for open duration
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Issue resolution timestamp from base issue; if NULL, durations measure to query-time current timestamp
      - name: creator_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Creator user identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_description
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue description text from base issue
      - name: due_date
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Due date from base issue as stored (string)
      - name: environment
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Environment field from base issue
      - name: issue_id_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary issue identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_type_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: parent_issue_id_1
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Secondary parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: priority_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority identifier from base issue
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: reporter_user_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter user identifier from base issue
      - name: resolution_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolution identifier from base issue
      - name: status_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Status identifier from base issue
      - name: status_changed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the last status change from base issue
      - name: issue_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue title or summary from base issue
      - name: updated_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Last update timestamp from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: work_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Work completion ratio from base issue
        tests:
        - work_ratio IS NULL OR work_ratio >= 0
      - name: revised_parent_issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Revised parent issue identifier from base issue
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue type name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue name from base issue
      - name: parent_issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Parent issue key from base issue
      - name: is_parent_epic
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the parent issue is an Epic; value from base issue
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee display name from base issue
      - name: assignee_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee timezone from base issue
      - name: assignee_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee email from base issue
      - name: reporter_email
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter email from base issue
      - name: reporter_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter display name from base issue
      - name: reporter_timezone
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Reporter timezone from base issue
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from base issue
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current status name from base issue
      - name: current_status_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current status category from base issue
      - name: resolution_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Resolution type name from base issue
      - name: current_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current priority name from base issue
      - name: current_sprint_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current sprint identifier from base issue
      - name: current_sprint_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current sprint name from base issue
      - name: count_sprint_changes
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Number of sprint changes from base issue
        tests:
        - count_sprint_changes >= 0
      - name: sprint_started_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint start timestamp from base issue
      - name: sprint_ended_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint end timestamp from base issue
      - name: sprint_completed_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Sprint completion timestamp from base issue
      - name: is_active_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: True if the current sprint is active; value from base issue
      - name: first_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of first assignment from base issue; used in assignment duration metrics
      - name: last_assigned_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp of the last assignment from base issue; used in assignment duration metrics
      - name: first_resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp when the issue was first resolved from base issue
      - name: fixes_versions
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Fix versions from base issue
      - name: affects_versions
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Affected versions from base issue
      - name: conversation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Concatenated conversation or comments from base issue
      - name: count_comments
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Total number of comments from base issue
        tests:
        - count_comments >= 0
      - name: open_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from creation to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if creation time is missing
        tests:
        - open_duration_seconds IS NULL OR open_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: any_assignment_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from first assignment to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if never assigned
        tests:
        - any_assignment_duration_seconds IS NULL OR any_assignment_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: last_assignment_duration_seconds
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Seconds from last assignment to resolution; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if no last assignment timestamp
        tests:
        - last_assignment_duration_seconds IS NULL OR last_assignment_duration_seconds >= 0
      - name: status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent status from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: components
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent component count from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - components IS NULL OR components >= 0
      - name: assignee
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent assignee display name from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: reporter
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent reporter display name from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Most recent priority from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
      - name: story_points
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent story points from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - story_points IS NULL OR story_points >= 0
      - name: story_point_estimate
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Most recent story point estimate from daily issue field history by date_day; NULL if no history; ties resolved arbitrarily
        tests:
        - story_point_estimate IS NULL OR story_point_estimate >= 0

references.name: intermediate.int_jira__issue_join
references.line_text: business_logic: '- Begin with all columns from intermediate.int_jira__issue_join as the base issue record. - From marts.jira__daily_issue_field_history, select the most recent record per issue_id based on the largest date_day; if multiple rows share the same most recent date_day, one is chosen arbitrarily because no secondary tie-break is defined. - Left join the most recent daily field history to the base issue on issue_id. - Compute three duration metrics in seconds: - open_duration_seconds: time from created_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if created_at is NULL. - any_assignment_duration_seconds: time from first_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if first_assigned_at is NULL. - last_assignment_duration_seconds: time from last_assigned_at to resolved_at; if unresolved, measured to the query-time current timestamp; NULL if last_assigned_at is NULL. - Output includes all base issue columns plus status, components, assignee, reporter, priority, story_points, and story_point_estimate from the most recent daily field history.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__issue_intelligence_analytics
      description: Advanced issue intelligence with anomaly detection, risk/opportunity scoring, predictions, and classification
      grain: One or more identical rows per issue_id (project-level self-join propagates duplicates)
      source_models:
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      business_logic: 'Build issue_enriched_base from marts.jira__issue_enhanced and compute: - total_lifecycle_days = days between created_at and resolved_at (or current time if unresolved) - assigned_duration_days = days between first_assigned_at and resolved_at (or current time) - Carry through count_comments, project/assignee fields, sprint flags Build issue_lifecycle_context from staging.stg_jira__issue providing default context per issue_id: - total_transitions=0; unique_statuses_visited=0; days_in_development=0; days_in_qa=0; days_in_intake=0 - regression_ratio=0.0; progress_efficiency=1.0; lifecycle_pattern=''Normal''; lifecycle_quality_score=75.0 - resolution_speed_category=''Standard Timeline''; high_complexity_risk=false Build issue_comparative_metrics via a self-join on project_id (ieb ⋈ ieb2): - Window metrics over ieb2 partitions: - project average/median/p75 lifecycle days by ieb.project_id - issue type average/median lifecycle days by ieb.issue_type - priority average lifecycle days by ieb.current_priority - assignee average lifecycle days and total issues by ieb.assignee_user_id - project average comments and issue type average comments - Note: The self-join creates multiple rows per issue_id; duplicates are preserved downstream Build issue_anomaly_detection by joining issue_enriched_base to issue_comparative_metrics on issue_id: - lifecycle_deviation_ratio = absolute difference from the project median lifecycle divided by that median (NULL if the median is 0 or NULL; non-negative otherwise) - type_deviation_ratio, assignee_deviation_ratio, comment_deviation_ratio computed similarly (not exposed) - lifecycle_outlier_status determined by thresholds: - more than 2×project p75 lifecycle → ''Statistical Outlier'' - more than 1.5×project p75 lifecycle → ''Above Normal Range'' - less than 0.5×project median lifecycle → ''Unusually Fast'' - else → ''Normal Range'' Build issue_risk_scoring by left joining lifecycle_context and anomaly_detection to issue_enriched_base: - age_risk_score: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days > 90 else 0 - process_risk_score: 15 if regression_ratio > 0.3 else 0 (NULL behaves as false → 0) - complexity_risk_score: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0 (NULL → 0) - engagement_risk_score: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0 - assignment_risk_score: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0 - deviation_risk_score: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio > 1 else 0 (NULL → 0) - collaboration_opportunity_score: 5 if count_comments > project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0 (NULL → 0) - efficiency_opportunity_score: 5 if total_lifecycle_days < project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0 (NULL → 0) - process_opportunity_score: 5 if progress_efficiency > 0.8 else 0 (NULL → 0) Build predictive_indicators from risk_scoring: - total_risk_score = sum of individual risk scores - total_opportunity_score = sum of opportunity scores - completion_probability: - resolved_at not null → 1.00 - else by total_lifecycle_days: ≤7→0.95; ≤14→0.85; ≤30→0.70; ≤60→0.50; ≤90→0.30; else 0.15 - predicted_completion_timeframe: - resolved_at not null → ''Already Completed'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' and assignee present → ''Within 1 Week'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Normal'' and assignee present → ''Within 2 Weeks'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Complex'' → ''Within 1 Month'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Problematic'' → ''Beyond 1 Month'' - assignee_name null → ''Requires Assignment'' - else → ''Unknown'' - recommended_action: - age_risk_score>0 and assignment_risk_score>0 → ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite'' - process_risk_score>0 → ''Review Process Issues'' - complexity_risk_score>0 → ''Break Down or Reassign'' - engagement_risk_score>0 → ''Encourage Collaboration'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Leverage Best Practices'' - unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>30 → ''Management Review Required'' - else → ''Monitor Progress'' Build intelligence_classification from predictive_indicators: - intelligence_score (0–100): start at 50, add 2×total_opportunity_score, subtract total_risk_score, add 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80, add 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then clamp to the 0–100 range - health_status by total_risk_score: ≥25 ''Critical''; ≥15 ''High Risk''; ≥8 ''Medium Risk''; >0 ''Low Risk''; else ''Healthy'' - strategic_importance: - current_priority with case-insensitive ''critical'' or ''high'' → ''Strategic'' - issue_type with case-insensitive ''epic'' → ''Strategic'' - total_opportunity_score>10 → ''High Value'' - lifecycle_pattern=''Efficient'' → ''Best Practice'' - else → ''Standard'' - intervention_urgency: - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥25 → ''Immediate'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥15 → ''Within 24 Hours'' - if unresolved and total_risk_score≥8 → ''Within Week'' - else if total_opportunity_score>10 → ''Study for Replication'' - else → ''Regular Monitoring'' Final output preserves duplicates from the self-join and is ordered by intelligence_score DESC, total_risk_score DESC.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique issue identifier from jira__issue_enhanced; join key throughout; duplicates may exist
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable issue key from Jira (e.g., PROJ-123); source value preserved
      - name: issue_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue type label from source (e.g., Bug, Story, Epic); case and spacing preserved
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current workflow status from source; exact text preserved
      - name: current_priority
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current priority from source; used for strategic importance classification (case-insensitive contains 'critical'/'high')
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from source associated with the issue; text preserved
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current assignee display name; may be NULL; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: total_lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Elapsed days from created_at to resolved_at (or current time if unresolved); fractional days preserved; non-negative
      - name: resolved_at
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Resolution timestamp; NULL for unresolved issues; drives completion_probability and timeframe
      - name: is_active_sprint
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Flag indicating whether the issue is in an active sprint; value passed through from source (may be NULL)
      - name: lifecycle_pattern
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Lifecycle pattern classification from context (default 'Normal'); may be NULL if context missing; used in timeframe prediction
      - name: lifecycle_quality_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Lifecycle quality score from context (default 75.0); boosts intelligence_score when >80; may be NULL
      - name: high_complexity_risk
        data_type: BOOLEAN
        description: Indicator from context of high complexity; NULL treated as false in scoring; contributes to complexity_risk_score
      - name: regression_ratio
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Ratio of regressions from context (default 0.0); NULL treated as not exceeding 0.3; contributes to process_risk_score
      - name: lifecycle_deviation_ratio
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Absolute deviation from project median lifecycle normalized by that median; NULL if median is 0 or NULL; non-negative
      - name: lifecycle_outlier_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Outlier classification based on project p75/median: ''Statistical Outlier''|''Above Normal Range''|''Unusually Fast''|''Normal Range''; may be NULL if comparative metrics missing'
      - name: age_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for issue age: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days>90 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for process regressions: 15 if regression_ratio>0.3 else 0; NULL regression_ratio yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: complexity_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for complexity: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0; NULL treated as false; always non-null'
      - name: engagement_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for low comment engagement: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0; always non-null'
      - name: assignment_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for missing assignee: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0; always non-null'
      - name: deviation_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk points for lifecycle deviation: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio>1 else 0; NULL deviation yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: collaboration_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high comment activity: 5 if count_comments>project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0; NULL avg yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: efficiency_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for faster-than-typical resolution: 5 if total_lifecycle_days<project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0; NULL median yields 0; always non-null'
      - name: process_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Opportunity points for high progress_efficiency: 5 if >0.8 else 0; NULL treated as 0; always non-null'
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of individual risk scores (age+process+complexity+engagement+assignment+deviation); integer; non-null
      - name: total_opportunity_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of opportunity scores (collaboration+efficiency+process); integer; non-null
      - name: completion_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: 'Probability of completion (resolved→1.00; else discrete thresholds by total_lifecycle_days: 0.95/0.85/0.70/0.50/0.30/0.15); non-null in [0,1]'
      - name: predicted_completion_timeframe
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Predicted timeframe: ''Already Completed''|''Within 1 Week''|''Within 2 Weeks''|''Within 1 Month''|''Beyond 1 Month''|''Requires Assignment''|''Unknown'' per lifecycle_pattern, assignee, and resolution'
      - name: recommended_action
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action recommendation based on risk/opportunity: ''Urgent: Assign and Expedite''|''Review Process Issues''|''Break Down or Reassign''|''Encourage Collaboration''|''Leverage Best Practices''|''Management Review Required''|''Monitor Progress'''
      - name: intelligence_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Overall score in [0,100]: 50 + 2×total_opportunity_score − total_risk_score, plus 15 if lifecycle_quality_score>80 and 10 if completion_probability>0.8, then capped to [0,100]'
      - name: health_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Issue health classification by total_risk_score: ''Critical''|''High Risk''|''Medium Risk''|''Low Risk''|''Healthy'''
      - name: strategic_importance
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Strategic label derived from priority, issue_type, opportunity, and lifecycle_pattern: ''Strategic''|''High Value''|''Best Practice''|''Standard'''
      - name: intervention_urgency
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Intervention urgency: if unresolved and risk high then ''Immediate''/''Within 24 Hours''/''Within Week''; else if high opportunity then ''Study for Replication''; else ''Regular Monitoring'''

references.name: marts.jira__issue_enhanced
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build issue_enriched_base from marts.jira__issue_enhanced and compute: - total_lifecycle_days = days between created_at and resolved_at (or current time if unresolved) - assigned_duration_days = days between first_assigned_at and resolved_at (or current time) - Carry through count_comments, project/assignee fields, sprint flags Build issue_lifecycle_context from staging.stg_jira__issue providing default context per issue_id: - total_transitions=0; unique_statuses_visited=0; days_in_development=0; days_in_qa=0; days_in_intake=0 - regression_ratio=0.0; progress_efficiency=1.0; lifecycle_pattern=''Normal''; lifecycle_quality_score=75.0 - resolution_speed_category=''Standard Timeline''; high_complexity_risk=false Build issue_comparative_metrics via a self-join on project_id (ieb ⋈ ieb2): - Window metrics over ieb2 partitions: - project average/median/p75 lifecycle days by ieb.project_id - issue type average/median lifecycle days by ieb.issue_type - priority average lifecycle days by ieb.current_priority - assignee average lifecycle days and total issues by ieb.assignee_user_id - project average comments and issue type average comments - Note: The self-join creates multiple rows per issue_id; duplicates are preserved downstream Build issue_anomaly_detection by joining issue_enriched_base to issue_comparative_metrics on issue_id: - lifecycle_deviation_ratio = absolute difference from the project median lifecycle divided by that median (NULL if the median is 0 or NULL; non-negative otherwise) - type_deviation_ratio, assignee_deviation_ratio, comment_deviation_ratio computed similarly (not exposed) - lifecycle_outlier_status determined by thresholds: - more than 2×project p75 lifecycle → ''Statistical Outlier'' - more than 1.5×project p75 lifecycle → ''Above Normal Range'' - less than 0.5×project median lifecycle → ''Unusually Fast'' - else → ''Normal Range'' Build issue_risk_scoring by left joining lifecycle_context and anomaly_detection to issue_enriched_base: - age_risk_score: 10 if unresolved and total_lifecycle_days > 90 else 0 - process_risk_score: 15 if regression_ratio > 0.3 else 0 (NULL behaves as false → 0) - complexity_risk_score: 10 if high_complexity_risk=true else 0 (NULL → 0) - engagement_risk_score: 5 if count_comments=0 else 0 - assignment_risk_score: 8 if assignee_user_id is NULL else 0 - deviation_risk_score: 7 if lifecycle_deviation_ratio > 1 else 0 (NULL → 0) - collaboration_opportunity_score: 5 if count_comments > project_avg_comments*1.5 else 0 (NULL → 0) - efficiency_opportunity_score: 5 if total_lifecycle_days < project_median_lifecycle_days*0.7 else 0 (NULL → 0) - process_opportunity_score: 5 if progress_efficiency > 0.8 else 0 (NULL → 0) Build predictive_indicators from risk_scoring: - total_risk_score = sum of individual risk scores - total_opportunity_score = sum of opportunity scores - completion_probability: - resolved_at not null → 1.00 - else by total_lifecycle_days: ≤7→0.95; - name: jira__issue_intelligence_simple
      description: Simplified issue intelligence with risk and completion probability derived from issue age and resolution
      grain: One row per issue_id
      source_models:
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced (issue_id, issue_key, issue_name, project_name, assignee_name, current_status, open_duration_seconds, resolved_at)
      business_logic: '- Source rows from marts.jira__issue_enhanced; no filtering or deduplication. - Pass through identifiers and context: issue_id, issue_key, issue_name, project_name, assignee_name, current_status. - Compute lifecycle_days by converting open_duration_seconds to days (divide by 86,400); fractional value; NULL propagates; no rounding. - Assign risk_level using strict thresholds for unresolved issues: - If resolved_at is NULL and open duration is more than 90 days → High Risk. - Else if resolved_at is NULL and open duration is more than 30 days → Medium Risk. - Else → Low Risk. Resolved issues are always Low Risk; unresolved with NULL duration is Low Risk. - Compute completion_probability: - If resolved_at is NOT NULL → 1.0. - Else if open duration is 7 days or less → 0.9. - Else if open duration is 30 days or less → 0.7. - Else → 0.3. Unresolved with NULL duration yields 0.3; values emitted with one decimal place. - Order rows by open_duration_seconds descending; no secondary sort; NULL positioning follows database default.'
      columns:
      - name: issue_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Unique issue identifier; one output row per issue_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: issue_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Readable issue key (e.g., PROJ-123)
      - name: issue_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Issue summary/title
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name
      - name: assignee_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Assignee name; NULL if unassigned
      - name: current_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Current workflow status
      - name: lifecycle_days
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Open duration in days; seconds divided by 86,400; fractional; NULL if source is NULL; no rounding
      - name: risk_level
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Risk bucket: unresolved and >90 days → High Risk; unresolved and >30 days → Medium Risk; otherwise Low Risk; resolved always Low Risk'
      - name: completion_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(2,1)
        description: Completion probability mapped to 1.0, 0.9, 0.7, or 0.3 based on resolution and age; unresolved with NULL duration → 0.3

- name: jira__project_enhanced
      description: Enhanced Jira project view combining base project fields, lead user details, aggregated epics/components, and project metrics in days and seconds
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__user
      - marts.jira__issue_enhanced
      - staging.stg_jira__component
      business_logic: '- Start from staging.stg_jira__project and produce one row per project_id with all base project attributes. - Build epics per project_id from marts.jira__issue_enhanced by keeping only issues whose type is Epic (case-insensitive) and concatenating their issue_name values with ", ". Set the issue counts to 0 when they are NULL or missing; carry all averages and medians (days and seconds) as-is and allow NULL. - Preserve original text casing and spacing; perform no trimming or normalization; apply no additional filtering beyond the Epic type for issues.'

blocks.original_text:
- name: jira__project_risk_assessment
      description: Project risk assessment with computed risk scores, probabilities, and recommendations derived from Jira issues, project metrics, and sprint/activity signals
      grain: One row per project_id
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      - staging.stg_jira__issue
      - staging.stg_jira__issue_link
      - staging.stg_jira__component
      - raw.issue_sprint_history
      - staging.stg_jira__sprint
      business_logic: 'Build deterministic risk metrics and recommendations per project_id from Jira data: - project_health_base: - Join intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics (pm) to staging.stg_jira__project (p) on project_id. - Select project_id, project_key, project_name. - Compute total_issues = pm.count_open_issues + pm.count_closed_issues (used for downstream thresholds). - Set overall_health_score = 75.0 (fixed), primary_risk_factor = ''Normal'', trajectory_status = ''Stable''. - project_financial_impact (left join on project_id): - Estimate project value points per issue by type: epic = 8.0; story = 3.0; task = 2.0; bug = 1.5; other or null = 2.0; sum across joined rows as estimated_project_value_points. - total_hours_invested = sum of time_spent_seconds converted to hours with nulls treated as zero. - delivered_value_points = sum of the same value weights but only for issues with a resolution timestamp. - high_delay_cost_issues = count of unresolved issues older than 90 days based on the difference between now and created_at. - project_trend_analysis (left join on project_id): - 30-day windows relative to current_date: - issues_created_30d = count of issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_30d = count of issues resolved in the last 30 days. - issues_created_prev_30d and issues_resolved_prev_30d = counts for the window 60 to 30 days ago. - Team activity: - active_assignees_30d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 30 days. - active_assignees_90d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 90 days. - High-priority trend (not surfaced in final columns but computed): counts constrained to high/critical priorities within the same windows. - project_complexity_analysis (left join on project_id): - unique_issue_types = distinct issue_type_id count (nulls excluded). - total_external_links = distinct count of issue links touching project issues, summing distinct source and distinct related issue IDs. - unique_components = distinct component_name count. - sprint_adoption_rate = average of a 1/0 indicator where 1 means an issue appears in any sprint; range 0–1. - Additional complexity signals (not all surfaced): unique_priorities, unique_statuses, sprints_involved, epic_count, child_issue_count, unique_reporters, unique_creators. - risk_factor_scoring: - value_delivery_percentage = delivered_value_points divided by estimated_project_value_points, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if estimated_project_value_points is zero, set to 0.0. - net_issue_growth_30d = issues_created_30d minus issues_resolved_30d (may be negative). - resolution_velocity_change_percent = percent change in issues resolved in the last 30 days vs the prior 30 days, rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no resolutions in the prior window, set to 0.0. - team_stability_percentage = active_assignees_30d divided by active_assignees_90d, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no active assignees in the last 90 days, set to 100.0. - Risk scores (each 0–20, exact buckets): - health_risk_score: - overall_health_score <= 40 → 20; <= 60 → 15; <= 75 → 10; <= 85 → 5; else → 0. - schedule_risk_score (relative to total_issues): - high_delay_cost_issues > total_issues × 30% → 20; > 20% → 15; > 10% → 10; > 0 → 5; else → 0. - resource_risk_score (by active_assignees_30d): - < 2 → 20; < 3 → 15; < 5 → 10; else → 0. - complexity_risk_score (using unique_components and total_external_links): - unique_components > 10 and total_external_links > 20 → 20; unique_components > 8 or total_external_links > 15 → 15; unique_components > 5 or total_external_links > 10 → 10; unique_components > 3 or total_external_links > 5 → 5; else → 0. - scope_risk_score (by net_issue_growth_30d relative to total_issues): - net growth > total_issues × 20% → 20; > 10% → 15; > 0 → 10; > −10% → 5; else → 0. - predictive_modeling: - total_risk_score = sum of the five risk scores (0–100). - success_probability (ordered rules; first match applies): - overall_health_score ≥ 85 and total_risk_score ≤ 20 → 0.95; - overall_health_score ≥ 75 and total_risk_score ≤ 40 → 0.80; - overall_health_score ≥ 60 and total_risk_score ≤ 60 → 0.65; - overall_health_score ≥ 50 and total_risk_score ≤ 80 → 0.40; - else → 0.20. - timeline_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - trajectory_status = ''Accelerating'' and total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Target Timeline''; - trajectory_status = ''Improving'' and total_risk_score ≤ 50 → ''Minor Delay Expected''; - trajectory_status = ''Stable'' and total_risk_score ≤ 70 → ''Moderate Delay Risk''; - trajectory_status in {''Declining'',''Critical Decline''} or total_risk_score > 70 → ''Significant Delay Risk''; - else → ''Timeline Uncertain''. - budget_impact_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - total_hours_invested > 0 and value_delivery_percentage < 50 → ''High Budget Overrun Risk''; - schedule_risk_score ≥ 15 → ''Moderate Budget Impact''; - total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Budget Expectations''; - else → ''Budget Risk Moderate''. - final_risk_assessment: - risk_category thresholds (first match applies): total_risk_score ≥ 80 → ''Critical Risk''; ≥ 60 → ''High Risk''; ≥ 40 → ''Medium Risk''; ≥ 20 → ''Low Risk''; else → ''Minimal Risk''. - primary_risk_driver = label of the maximum among the five risk scores with tie-break order: Project Health, then Schedule Delays, then Resource Constraints, then Technical Complexity, else Scope Management. - recommended_intervention thresholds: ≥ 80 → ''Immediate Executive Review Required''; ≥ 60 → ''Project Manager Intervention Needed''; ≥ 40 → ''Team Lead Review and Action Plan''; ≥ 20 → ''Regular Monitoring and Minor Adjustments''; else → ''Continue Current Approach''. - strategic_priority_recommendation: - success_probability ≥ 0.8 and estimated_project_value_points > 50 → ''High Priority - High Success''; - success_probability ≥ 0.6 and estimated_project_value_points > 30 → ''Medium Priority - Good Prospects''; - success_probability < 0.4 and total_risk_score > 60 → ''Low Priority - Consider Restructuring''; - success_probability < 0.3 → ''Consider Project Termination''; - else → ''Standard Priority''. - Output one row per project_id. When viewed directly from the SQL, rows are ordered by total_risk_score descending, then success_probability ascending; ordering does not affect computed values.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier; grouping key for the output; exactly one row per project_id
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_key
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Human-readable project key from Jira (joined from stg_jira__project)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from Jira (joined from stg_jira__project)
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: overall_health_score
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,1)
        description: Project health score used for risk bucketing; currently fixed to 75.0; scale 0–100
        tests:
        - overall_health_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: primary_risk_factor
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label from project_health_base indicating the primary risk factor (currently 'Normal')
      - name: trajectory_status
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Text label of project trajectory (e.g., Accelerating/Improving/Stable/Declining); drives timeline prediction
      - name: estimated_project_value_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Sum of issue value points by type (epic=8, story=3, task=2, bug=1.5, other or null=2); unit: points'
        tests:
        - estimated_project_value_points >= 0
      - name: delivered_value_points
        data_type: DECIMAL(38,1)
        description: 'Sum of value points for issues that are resolved using the same weights; unit: points'
        tests:
        - delivered_value_points >= 0
      - name: total_hours_invested
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: 'Sum of time_spent_seconds converted to hours; nulls treated as 0; unit: hours'
        tests:
        - total_hours_invested >= 0
      - name: high_delay_cost_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of unresolved issues older than 90 days based on created_at; non-negative
        tests:
        - high_delay_cost_issues >= 0
      - name: value_delivery_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Delivered value as a percentage of estimated value, rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when estimated is 0; range 0–100
        tests:
        - value_delivery_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: net_issue_growth_30d
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Issues created in the last 30 days minus issues resolved in the last 30 days; may be negative
      - name: resolution_velocity_change_percent
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Percent change in issues resolved vs the prior 30-day window, rounded to 1 decimal; 0 when no prior resolutions; may be negative
      - name: team_stability_percentage
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Active assignees in last 30 days divided by those in last 90 days, times 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; 100 when 90-day denominator is 0
        tests:
        - team_stability_percentage BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: unique_issue_types
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of issue_type_id per project; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - unique_issue_types >= 0
      - name: unique_components
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct count of component_name per project; nulls excluded
        tests:
        - unique_components >= 0
      - name: total_external_links
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Distinct issue links touching project issues, summed from distinct source and related issue IDs
        tests:
        - total_external_links >= 0
      - name: sprint_adoption_rate
        data_type: DOUBLE
        description: Average of a 1/0 indicator for issues appearing in any sprint across joined sprint history; range 0–1
        tests:
        - sprint_adoption_rate BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      - name: health_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 based on overall_health_score: <=40→20, <=60→15, <=75→10, <=85→5, else→0'
        tests:
        - health_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: schedule_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 using high_delay_cost_issues relative to total_issues: >30%→20, >20%→15, >10%→10, >0→5, else→0'
        tests:
        - schedule_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: resource_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 by active_assignees_30d: <2→20, <3→15, <5→10, else→0'
        tests:
        - resource_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: complexity_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 using unique_components and total_external_links: (>10 and >20)→20; (>8 or >15)→15; (>5 or >10)→10; (>3 or >5)→5; else→0'
        tests:
        - complexity_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: scope_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: 'Risk bucket 0–20 by net_issue_growth_30d vs total_issues: >20%→20; >10%→15; >0→10; >-10%→5; else→0'
        tests:
        - scope_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 20
      - name: total_risk_score
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Sum of the five risk scores (health + schedule + resource + complexity + scope); range 0–100
        tests:
        - total_risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100
      - name: success_probability
        data_type: DECIMAL(3,2)
        description: Fixed probabilities (0.95/0.80/0.65/0.40/0.20) from ordered rules using overall_health_score and total_risk_score; range 0–1
        tests:
        - success_probability BETWEEN 0 AND 1
      - name: timeline_prediction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Time-to-completion label from ordered rules combining trajectory_status and total_risk_score
      - name: budget_impact_prediction
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Budget impact label from ordered rules using hours invested, delivery percentage, schedule risk, and total risk
      - name: risk_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Overall risk label from total_risk_score thresholds: Critical/High/Medium/Low/Minimal'
        tests:
        - risk_category IN ('Low Risk', 'Medium Risk', 'High Risk', 'Critical Risk', 'Minimal Risk')
      - name: primary_risk_driver
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Dominant risk dimension chosen by the highest of the five risk scores with tie-break order: Health > Schedule > Resource > Complexity > Scope'
      - name: recommended_intervention
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Action guidance from total_risk_score thresholds: Executive Review/PM Intervention/Team Lead Action/Monitoring/Continue'
      - name: strategic_priority_recommendation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Priority advice based on success_probability and estimated value, with overrides for low success and high total risk

references.name: intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics
references.line_text: business_logic: 'Build deterministic risk metrics and recommendations per project_id from Jira data: - project_health_base: - Join intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics (pm) to staging.stg_jira__project (p) on project_id. - Select project_id, project_key, project_name. - Compute total_issues = pm.count_open_issues + pm.count_closed_issues (used for downstream thresholds). - Set overall_health_score = 75.0 (fixed), primary_risk_factor = ''Normal'', trajectory_status = ''Stable''. - project_financial_impact (left join on project_id): - Estimate project value points per issue by type: epic = 8.0; story = 3.0; task = 2.0; bug = 1.5; other or null = 2.0; sum across joined rows as estimated_project_value_points. - total_hours_invested = sum of time_spent_seconds converted to hours with nulls treated as zero. - delivered_value_points = sum of the same value weights but only for issues with a resolution timestamp. - high_delay_cost_issues = count of unresolved issues older than 90 days based on the difference between now and created_at. - project_trend_analysis (left join on project_id): - 30-day windows relative to current_date: - issues_created_30d = count of issues created in the last 30 days. - issues_resolved_30d = count of issues resolved in the last 30 days. - issues_created_prev_30d and issues_resolved_prev_30d = counts for the window 60 to 30 days ago. - Team activity: - active_assignees_30d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 30 days. - active_assignees_90d = distinct assignees on issues created in the last 90 days. - High-priority trend (not surfaced in final columns but computed): counts constrained to high/critical priorities within the same windows. - project_complexity_analysis (left join on project_id): - unique_issue_types = distinct issue_type_id count (nulls excluded). - total_external_links = distinct count of issue links touching project issues, summing distinct source and distinct related issue IDs. - unique_components = distinct component_name count. - sprint_adoption_rate = average of a 1/0 indicator where 1 means an issue appears in any sprint; range 0–1. - Additional complexity signals (not all surfaced): unique_priorities, unique_statuses, sprints_involved, epic_count, child_issue_count, unique_reporters, unique_creators. - risk_factor_scoring: - value_delivery_percentage = delivered_value_points divided by estimated_project_value_points, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if estimated_project_value_points is zero, set to 0.0. - net_issue_growth_30d = issues_created_30d minus issues_resolved_30d (may be negative). - resolution_velocity_change_percent = percent change in issues resolved in the last 30 days vs the prior 30 days, rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no resolutions in the prior window, set to 0.0. - team_stability_percentage = active_assignees_30d divided by active_assignees_90d, multiplied by 100 and rounded to 1 decimal; if there were no active assignees in the last 90 days, set to 100.0. - Risk scores (each 0–20, exact buckets): - health_risk_score: - overall_health_score <= 40 → 20; <= 60 → 15; <= 75 → 10; <= 85 → 5; else → 0. - schedule_risk_score (relative to total_issues): - high_delay_cost_issues > total_issues × 30% → 20; > 20% → 15; > 10% → 10; > 0 → 5; else → 0. - resource_risk_score (by active_assignees_30d): - < 2 → 20; < 3 → 15; < 5 → 10; else → 0. - complexity_risk_score (using unique_components and total_external_links): - unique_components > 10 and total_external_links > 20 → 20; unique_components > 8 or total_external_links > 15 → 15; unique_components > 5 or total_external_links > 10 → 10; unique_components > 3 or total_external_links > 5 → 5; else → 0. - scope_risk_score (by net_issue_growth_30d relative to total_issues): - net growth > total_issues × 20% → 20; > 10% → 15; > 0 → 10; > −10% → 5; else → 0. - predictive_modeling: - total_risk_score = sum of the five risk scores (0–100). - success_probability (ordered rules; first match applies): - overall_health_score ≥ 85 and total_risk_score ≤ 20 → 0.95; - overall_health_score ≥ 75 and total_risk_score ≤ 40 → 0.80; - overall_health_score ≥ 60 and total_risk_score ≤ 60 → 0.65; - overall_health_score ≥ 50 and total_risk_score ≤ 80 → 0.40; - else → 0.20. - timeline_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - trajectory_status = ''Accelerating'' and total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Target Timeline''; - trajectory_status = ''Improving'' and total_risk_score ≤ 50 → ''Minor Delay Expected''; - trajectory_status = ''Stable'' and total_risk_score ≤ 70 → ''Moderate Delay Risk''; - trajectory_status in {''Declining'',''Critical Decline''} or total_risk_score > 70 → ''Significant Delay Risk''; - else → ''Timeline Uncertain''. - budget_impact_prediction (ordered rules; first match applies): - total_hours_invested > 0 and value_delivery_percentage < 50 → ''High Budget Overrun Risk''; - schedule_risk_score ≥ 15 → ''Moderate Budget Impact''; - total_risk_score ≤ 30 → ''Within Budget Expectations''; - else → ''Budget Risk Moderate''. - final_risk_assessment: - risk_category thresholds (first match applies): total_risk_score ≥ 80 → ''Critical Risk''; ≥ 60 → ''High Risk''; ≥ 40 → ''Medium Risk''; ≥ 20 → ''Low Risk''; else → ''Minimal Risk''. - primary_risk_driver = label of the maximum among the five risk scores with tie-break order: Project Health, then Schedule Delays, then Resource Constraints, then Technical Complexity, else Scope Management. - recommended_intervention thresholds: ≥ 80 → ''Immediate Executive Review Required''; ≥ 60 → ''Project Manager Intervention Needed''; ≥ 40 → ''Team Lead Review and Action Plan''; ≥ 20 → ''Regular Monitoring and Minor Adjustments''; else → ''Continue Current Approach''. - strategic_priority_recommendation: - success_probability ≥ 0.8 and estimated_project_value_points > 50 → ''High Priority - High Success''; - success_probability ≥ 0.6 and estimated_project_value_points > 30 → ''Medium Priority - Good Prospects''; - success_probability < 0.4 and total_risk_score > 60 → ''Low Priority - Consider Restructuring''; - success_probability < 0.3 → ''Consider Project Termination''; - else → ''Standard Priority''. - Output one row per project_id. When viewed directly from the SQL, rows are ordered by total_risk_score descending, then success_probability ascending; ordering does not affect computed values.'

      grain: One row per project_id present in both source tables (inner join)
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics
      - staging.stg_jira__project
      business_logic: '- Inner join intermediate.int_jira__project_metrics (pm) with staging.stg_jira__project (p) on project_id; only projects present in both sources are included. - Selected fields: pm.project_id, p.project_name, pm.count_closed_issues, pm.count_open_issues, pm.avg_close_time_days (integral day count as provided). - Risk category precedence: 1) High Risk if open issues are more than twice the closed issues. 2) Otherwise, Medium Risk if the average close time in days is greater than 30. 3) Otherwise, Low Risk. Null handling: any null in the compared fields makes the check fail; if both checks fail, the result is Low Risk. - Project value: 1) High Value if closed issues are greater than 50. 2) Otherwise, Medium Value if closed issues are greater than 20. 3) Otherwise, Standard Value. Null handling: a null closed-issue count results in Standard Value. - Final ordering: sort by count_open_issues in descending order; no secondary sort, filtering, rounding, or de-duplication beyond the inner join.'
      columns:
      - name: project_id
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project identifier from metrics used as the inner-join key.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - unique
      - name: project_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Project name from the project staging table, carried through unchanged.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: count_closed_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total closed issues from metrics; used to determine risk (twice-open check) and value tiers; nulls are allowed and not transformed.
      - name: count_open_issues
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total open issues from metrics; used for the high-risk check; nulls are allowed and not transformed.
      - name: avg_close_time_days
        data_type: DECIMAL(18,0)
        description: Average issue resolution time in whole days from metrics; nulls allowed; no rounding performed here.
      - name: risk_category
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High Risk if open issues exceed twice closed; else Medium Risk if average close time is over 30 days; otherwise Low Risk; null comparisons default to Low Risk.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - risk_category IN ('High Risk', 'Medium Risk', 'Low Risk')
      - name: project_value
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: High Value if closed issues exceed 50; else Medium Value if over 20; otherwise Standard Value; null closed-issue counts default to Standard Value.
        tests:
        - not_null
        - project_value IN ('High Value', 'Medium Value', 'Standard Value')
